∀ {k : Type} [inst_2 : Field k] {G : Type} [inst_4 : Group G] [inst_5 : Finite G]
  (V : FDRep k G) (g : G) {u v : Set ℕ},
  u ⊆ v →
    Disjoint
        (insert (minpoly ℤ (V.character g)).natDegree
          (Set.Ioc 0 (Order.pred (minpoly ℤ (V.character g)).natDegree)))
        v →
      ∃ a', Set.Ioc 0 (minpoly ℤ (V.character g)).natDegree ∩ v ⊆ a' ∧ IsCompl a' u

referees.justification: The 7-step synthesis across FDRep, minpoly, Set resists single-lemma lookup and yields a proof-to-statement ratio of 2.56, meriting archival as a theorem. While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across FDRep, minpoly, Set, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 7 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a theorem of modest significance (9/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.
